definitions.explanation: A book or written work widely recognized as excellent or important. Refers specifically to written works, not art or music.

examples.japanese: ⟦これ→これ：00963_kore⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{経済学|けいざいがく}→経済学：19376_keizaigaku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{名著|めいちょ}だ。
examples.english: This is a classic work of economics.

examples.japanese: ⟦{夏休|なつやす}み→夏休み：02925_natsuyasumi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{名著|めいちょ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{読|よ}みたい→読む：00426_yomu⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{思|おも}っている→思う：00492_omou⟧。
examples.english: I'm planning to read some classic books over summer vacation.

examples.japanese: ⟦{時代|じだい}→時代：01424_jidai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{超|こ}えて→超える：01942_koeru⟧{読|よ}み{継|つ}がれて⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧{名著|めいちょ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{集|あつ}めた→集める：01170_atsumeru⟧ブック⟦リスト→リスト：09786_risuto⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}った→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧。
examples.english: I made a book list of masterpieces that have been read across generations.

notes:
FORMS:
{名|めい} (famous, excellent) + {著|ちょ} (book, written work). Part of the {名|めい}～ prefix family that denotes excellence.

RELATED {名|めい}～ COMPOUNDS:
- ⟦{名作|めいさく}→名作：11869_meisaku⟧ (masterpiece — broader, includes films, art, etc.)
- ⟦{名曲|めいきょく}→名曲：17476_meikyoku⟧ (famous piece of music)
- ⟦{名画|めいが}→名画：17385_meiga⟧ (famous painting; classic film)
- {名演|めいえん} (famous performance)

USAGE:
{名著|めいちょ} is specifically for books and written works, while ⟦{名作|めいさく}→名作：11869_meisaku⟧ can refer to any creative work.
